entries.note: The sender's consignment entering XDP's system. The page shows "--"; the wording is the XDP app's label for the type.
A label printed with the order, and again for a return. The page shows "--"; it moves nothing.
The collection depot has the parcel from the sender. The page wraps it in its depot system's name, Spirit Status: "At Collection Depot"; older rows have the plain wording.
The delivery depot has the parcel; XDP's newer page calls it being prepared for delivery. Wrapped like the collection scan.
The route number varies. XDP's newer page keeps the parcel being prepared for delivery until the round is scheduled.

entries.note: The day's round with its two-hour window; the route and window vary. XDP's newer page counts the parcel out for delivery from here.
The driver's next stop, with how the round runs against the window: also "Late by 2 minutes" and "Early by an hour". The page shows only that part; the adapter adds "Next stop:".
Wrapped in the round's system name, DriverX Status: "Delivered", and ScanX on older rows.
DriverX Status: "Return": the driver took the parcel back undelivered.
The way back to the sender starts; the adapter files every later scan as returned.
The XDP app's label for the type.
